findings.applicability: Account-wide Codex allowance replay with integer reset deadlines drifting six to ten seconds within a coherent quota progression.
diagnostics: Inspect exact reset seconds, accepted percentage chronology and stale counts before changing denominator scope.
Compare reset 0, jitter ±6/±8/±10 and returns to the original anchor; assert one cohort and conserved matched work.
Test ±11 beyond the original anchor after an intermediate ±5 reading; retain real reset retirement and gap exclusions.
findings.limitations: A real reset within ten seconds is indistinguishable from timestamp drift. Fixed-anchor jitter beyond ten seconds still splits cohorts. Missing readings remain excluded; low-confidence shared quota rates do not identify individual model costs. Live work durations grow.
findings.remedy: Use a fixed ten-second tolerance from the original cohort anchor; preserve chronological retirement, conflicts, stale percentages and actual observation-gap exclusions. Do not replace matched work with all model time.
symptoms: Daily consumption work is much smaller than model totals and two reset rows display the same minute.
Frequent valid quota readings are classified as retired after a sparse deadline drifts by several seconds.
findings.verification: Six signed-jitter cases observed RED as duplicate rows; focused 85 tests, mypy and Ruff passed. Source and installed reports collapsed false cohorts; installed JSON had 2 matched plus 1 genuine gap-excluded point, 3.412598611 matched hours vs 3.427554167 model hours and only one stale reading. Installed burn.py matched tested source.

findings.applicability: Recent-session pickers that can show identity metadata before dialogue and AI evidence finish indexing.

findings.remedy: Use validated lock-free cached metadata or bounded native headers/title tails; mark dialogue pending, refresh in bounded background passes, defer inference/manual requests, preserve provisional rows and avoid pruning unknown recaps. Keep diagnostics in private disposable storage with concise in-UI progress and bounded explicit details.
symptoms: recent picker waits for full archive indexing before fzf
malformed-record warnings overwrite interactive UI
cached startup waits behind index lock
findings.verification: Defining checks observed RED then GREEN; final complete Codex suite160 tests passed88.946s. Source and installed real CLI/fzf cold/cache/locked/malformed checks open within2s, resume exact UUID/cwd, preserve source bytes and clean up.
